notes.title: Hotifx 1.0a & Trading Cards - Happy Holidays!
notes.notes:
Hello players,

CatchACat would like to thank all of you for playing Elena and giving valuable feedback. Elena is our first major release on a commercial platform and we want you all to have a great experience. We are happy to see that so many people enjoy playing our game. That’s why we tried to fix some of the more pressing issues of the game just before the holidays.

Here’s a list on the issues fixed in this version:
Features:
- Added Trading Cards! ːsteamhappyː
Bugfixes: 
- Fixed a bug where the pause button were visible in the credits.
- Fixed a bug where the pause menu wasn’t translated to the selected language.
- Fixed a bug where you could walk through a wall and fall into infinity.
Improvements: 
- Changed the default menu settings to English.
- Changed a trigger in the final scene to start automatically after a certain amount of time.
- Increased ScreenPercenage for Ultra and High settings in both VR and PC versions.
- Added a tutorial to connect the notes on the pinboard.

The next major patch is scheduled for January and will include more graphics options (like adjustable screen percentage / super sampling) as well as better controller support.

Happy holidays from Team CatchACat!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25952783/4a8ae613b9431e1fb1c2214db0118cb24c0ea450.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Elena now available!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that "Elena – Displaced Reality" is now available on Steam!

After countless hours of development and great times with our team "Catch A Cat" the time has come to show it to you.
We hope you'll all have an awesome experience with or without VR headset when exploring the world of Elena.

As an early christmas gift , we discounted it by 20% for you, so start playing and have fun!
